problems.title: Compile Stan calls to the RK45 delay differential equation solver
problems.summary: Compiler feature for the Stan Math solver. A Stan model can pass a derivative function that reads lagged states to dde_rk45 or dde_rk45_tol. The compiler checks argument types and emits the corresponding stan::math call.

commits.title: Add variadic dde_rk45 and dde_rk45_tol signatures

fix.why_together: One commit adds both signatures and their type-checking and C++ generation tests to stanc3 v2.39.0.

requires.name: Stan Math DDE solver
requires.why: The generated C++ calls the variadic dde_rk45 or dde_rk45_tol implementation in Stan Math.

problems.title: Compile Torsten event-schedule calls to pmx_solve_dde_rk45
problems.summary: Compiler feature for the Torsten event solver. The pmx_solve_dde_rk45 function accepts a dosing schedule, delays and state history. stanc3 checks the selected overload and emits a torsten::pmx_solve_dde_rk45 call.

commits.title: Import Torsten's stanc3 delta from metrumresearchgroup/stanc3
Collapse Torsten's pmx_solve overload generators into one helper

fix.why_together: The first commit imports Torsten’s function signatures and C++ namespace handling from metrumresearchgroup/stanc3. The second factors out their overload generator. The third uses that helper to register and test the DDE solver. These three original patches also apply to v2.39.0 without the separate variadic Stan DDE signatures.

problems.title: Pass an analytic Jacobian to Stan ODE, DAE and delay solvers
problems.summary: Models can pass a second function returning a Jacobian matrix and use ode_jacobian_error, dae_jacobian_error or dde_jacobian_error to compare it with autodiff. stanc3 checks the two function signatures and emits both C++ functors.

commits.title: Add solver overloads taking a Jacobian UDF and *_jacobian_error checks

fix.why_together: One compiler commit adds overload selection, type checking, C++ code generation and the corresponding positive and negative tests. The DDE overloads extend the variadic delay solver signatures already on this line.

requires.name: Stan Math analytic Jacobian overloads
requires.why: The generated calls need the two-functor ODE, DAE and DDE overloads and the three Jacobian-check functions. The public Stan Math dogfood commit 5ee1551154db14debb2c137663fcdfd6fe800c87 contains these implementations.

problems.title: Supply an analytic Jacobian to Torsten event solvers
problems.summary: A Stan model can pass its Jacobian immediately after its right-hand side in pmx_solve_rk45, pmx_solve_bdf, pmx_solve_adams and pmx_solve_dde_rk45. The callback takes the same arguments as the right-hand side, including lagged states for DDEs, and returns a matrix.

commits.title: Add pmx_solve_rk45/bdf/adams/dde_rk45 overloads taking a Jacobian UDF

fix.why_together: One commit extends the Torsten signature generator with 90 Jacobian variants per solver and adds positive, negative and C++ generation tests. It applies on top of the existing Torsten event-solver signatures.
